referenceDna.annotatedDescription: An immersive warm interior opening with small centered serif copy gives way to a pale editorial introduction instead of a conventional feature-card row. Fine uppercase navigation and a monogram-like mark rest over a light, low-profile header. Small elegant serif headings and uppercase labels, with narrow calm paragraphs and high whitespace ratios. The page sequence runs from immersive opening photograph to introductory statement band to studio split toward award mark strip, enquiry split, quiet footer. Full-height residential interiors alternate with copy and a three-image project gallery; object and joinery details provide close-range texture. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
